page.layout: Top: two circular woodcut medallion portraits side by side, David (left) and Solomon (right), each with inscription around its rim. Below them: one page of running text in two paragraphs, no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: DAVID filius Iesse (Iesse vocabatur quoque Isaï) regnauit super tribum Iuda in Hebron, anno mundi 2 8 9 r. ante Christum natum 1 0 7 1. quo tempore etiam Isboseth constituitur Rex super Israelem, regnauit autem Dauid super Iudā & Ben-iamin in Hebron septem annos, & sex menses: præterea super alias decem tribus, & super totum Israelem annos 3 3. Hic cùm gregem patris pasceret, leonē & vrsum apprehensō mento oc-cidit: quare nec diffidit adfuturum sibi Dei auxilium aduersus Goliath: igitur lapide funda iacto, gigantem interfecit. Prophe-ta Nathan eum homicidij arguit. Præterea propofuit ei Deus per Gad Prophetam tria pœnarum genera, quòd populum nu-merasset: aut septem annorum famem, aut trium mensium per-sequente hoste, fugam, aut trium dierum pestilentiā: vltimum elegit, inquiēs melius esse vt in manus Domini inciderent. tunc vsque adeo sæuiit pestis vt 7 0 0 0 0. virorum hac lue perirent, ad ædificationem templi populū & Salomonē filium hortatus, descriptionem ac necessaria ad ædificationem dedit. annos natus 70. moritur, ac sepelitur in Beth-lehem. 2. lib. Reg. 11. cap. & sequen. Ioseph. lib. Antiq. 6. cap. 10. & sequentibus.

SALOMON filius Dauid ex Beth-sabea, incipit imperare in Israël anno mundi 2 9 3 1. ante Christum natum 1 0 3 1. Hic sapientiam à domino postulauit, & impetrauit. habuit ad ædificationem têpli 70000. qui onera portarent, latomorum 80000. præpositorum 3300. locutus est 3000. parabolas, fuerunt carmina eius 5000. annuus reditus eius erat 666. talentorum auri, excepto vectigali, valebátque talentum auri ad 5000. aureorum. mira potes legere à cap. 4. li. 3. Reg. ad 10. item apud Iosep. lib. 8. vxores habuit quasi reginas 700, & concubinas 300. quæ cùm ex gentibus essent, vt eis gratificaretur, ad idololatriam deflexit: quare decem tribus à filio suo ablatæ. regnauit annos 40.

page.notes: Two woodcut medallion portraits at the top: David (left, crowned, with beard) and Solomon (right, crowned, with beard). Their inscriptions are transcribed above as lines. The inscription at the right of David's medallion is partly worn and reads as given. No marginal notes, catchword or signature on this page. Printed numerals in the text are set with spaces between digits, copied as printed.
